_reason: mirror/docs/21-R3/FolderClass.html has no Parameter table for 4D.Folder.new (logged by stage O2b as param_table_missing), so stage O3 could not resolve `pathType` or `folderConstant` beyond bare Integer. Both are documented in the page prose and in the 'File and Folder' constants theme of references/4d-constants-registry.json; typed here by hand. Additionally, the `{ ; * }` that FolderClass.html shows in both syntax lines is a documentation error carried over from the classic `Folder` command (the page itself says 4D.Folder.new() "is identical to the Folder command (shortcut)" and supplies no parameter table). tool4d accepts `Folder("/tmp"; fk posix path; *)` but rejects `4D.Folder.new("/tmp"; fk posix path; *)` with a bare "Syntax error", and the sibling 4D.File.new documents no `*` at all. The `*` parameter is therefore dropped from params[] here; rawSyntax is left byte-identical to syntaxEN, as the gate requires.

4D.Folder.new.pathType.description: Path-type constants of the 'File and Folder' theme, selecting how `path` is interpreted.

4D.Folder.new.folderConstant.description: Folder-shortcut constants of the 'File and Folder' theme that designate a well-known 4D file/folder location instead of a path string.

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file or folder, or a filesystem pathname ("/DATA", "/RESOURCES", ...). Relative paths are resolved against the project folder.

params.name: pathType
params.description: How `path` is spelled. Defaults to `fk platform path`.

params.name: folderConstant
params.description: A folder-shortcut constant naming a well-known 4D location, instead of a path.
